name: Portal Field
description: An organically warped luminous halo with a soft chromatic fringe behind real content.
usage: Compose real content as children; keep essential controls above the decorative field.
Choose balanced, warm or cool SahaJiv accents and keep a visible pause control for continuous movement.
accessibility: The canvas and static SVG are decorative and hidden from assistive technology; children retain native semantics.
Reduced motion, shared motion/flow off, hidden tabs and offscreen stages stop animation. Local pointer response never captures the native cursor or touch scroll.
A deterministic static organic halo remains when WebGL is unavailable or lost.
landing: Optional single hero or final invitation backdrop at low intensity; skip if another ambient field already occupies that scene.
notes: Original annular distance shader with analytic domain warp, narrow luminous core, broad fringe and a quiet inner wash. No upstream authentication UI, external font or dependency copied.
observation: The supplied portal-field.html uses warped arc signed distance, exponential core/fringe falloff, pointer offset and a low-alpha wash. Existing MagicRings draws crisp expanding circular arcs; ContourField renders topographic bands.

props.name: children
props.description: Real caller content placed above the decorative artwork.

props.name: tone
props.description: Pairs existing theme-aware SahaJiv accent colors.

props.name: speed
props.description: Relative animation pace, bounded to 0–3. Zero is still.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Halo color strength, bounded to 0–2.

props.name: distortion
props.description: Organic contour/domain warp, bounded to 0–1.5.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Enable small local pointer parallax while moving; touch keeps scrolling.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stop optional movement; readable content and a still artwork remain.

props.name: size
props.description: Stage or heading scale; all sizes remain responsive.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional root class names. Native div attributes are also accepted.

name: Article Headings
description: Semantic article headings resolve through a brief, grapheme-safe noise frontier.
usage: Supply stable unique item ids, full titles and optional metadata or hrefs; choose the correct heading level for the surrounding page.
Change replayKey to deliberately decode again. Pausing or leaving view restores complete text and cancels the current sequence.
Use on a compact editorial list; duration and total stagger are bounded, and large titles/lists retain readable static text.
accessibility: Actual complete heading text remains in the accessibility tree throughout; decorative changing glyphs are aria-hidden and never announced.
Each glyph reserves its true footprint so noise does not move the heading, metadata or neighboring content.
Reduced motion, shared motion/flow off and hidden/offscreen stages keep exact still headings. Optional links remain keyboard accessible with visible focus.
landing: Optional editorial or field-notes section near the bottom of the landing page; use once on entry, keep the main hero to the chosen headline effect.
notes: Original deterministic noise/frontier implementation over grapheme slots. It does not mutate semantic heading text like the upstream text-node walker. Replays are explicit and cancellations settle readable content.
observation: ArticleHeadings.tsx composes numbered semantic h2 rows. articleHeadingDecode.ts reveals a left-to-right eased prefix, then a bounded scramble band and probabilistic noisy tail; it restores original nodes on cleanup. TextReveal has entrance motion but no decode noise/frontier.

props.name: items
props.description: Each item: { id: string; title: string; meta?: string; href?: string }. Ids must be unique and stable.

props.name: label
props.description: Section eyebrow shown with the entry count.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Semantic heading level for each article title.

props.name: duration
props.description: Decode duration in milliseconds, bounded to 100–3000.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Row delay in milliseconds; total stagger is compressed to at most 1200ms.

props.name: scrambleLength
props.description: Maximum noisy frontier width in graphemes, bounded to 0–30.

props.name: preserveChance
props.description: Fraction of original graphemes retained inside the noise band, bounded to 0–1.

props.name: tailChance
props.description: Fraction of tail graphemes replaced with decorative symbols, bounded to 0–1.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Changing this value explicitly restarts the sequence when motion is allowed.

props.name: onDecodeComplete
props.description: Called after the visible active sequence finishes, not after cancellation or a quiet-state fallback.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stop optional movement; readable content and a still artwork remain.

props.name: size
props.description: Stage or heading scale; all sizes remain responsive.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional root class names. Native div attributes are also accepted.
